User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the PlayNite application.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the user entity, from Firebase Auth.

displayName.description: Public display name of the user.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

joined.description: Date and time the user registered.

watchLater.description: A list of video IDs the user wants to watch later.

Video.title: Video
Video.description: Represents a video in the PlayNite application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the video entity.

uploadedAt.description: Date and time the video was uploaded.

duration.description: Duration of the video in seconds.

views.description: Number of times the video has been viewed.

tags.description: List of tags associated with the video.

creator.description: Display name of the creator at the time of upload.

isEmbedded.description: True if the video is from an external embeddable source.

embedUrl.description: The URL for the iframe embed source.

embedProvider.description: The provider of the embedded video.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Represents a category for videos in the PlayNite application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the category entity.

Tag.title: Tag
Tag.description: Represents a tag for videos in the PlayNite application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the tag entity.

Favorite.title: Favorite
Favorite.description: Represents a video added to a user's favorites list.

addedDate.description: Date and time the video was added to the favorites list.

VideoHistory.title: VideoHistory
VideoHistory.description: Represents a user's video viewing history.

watchDate.description: Date and time the video was watched.

title.description: The title of the video at the time it was watched.

thumbnailUrl.description: The thumbnail URL of the video at the time it was watched.

Playlist.title: Playlist
Playlist.description: Represents a custom video playlist created by a user.

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: Represents a comment on a video.

VideoLike.title: VideoLike
VideoLike.description: Represents a like or dislike on a video by a user.

Follower.title: Follower
Follower.description: Represents a follower relationship. The document ID is the ID of the user being followed.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents a notification for a user.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles. Accessible only to the user and admins.

/users/{userId}/favorites/{videoId}.description: Stores a user's favorited videos. Document ID is the video ID. Accessible only to the user.

/users/{userId}/video_history/{videoId}.description: Stores a user's video viewing history. Document ID is the video ID. Accessible only to the user.

/users/{userId}/playlists/{playlistId}.description: Stores playlists created by a user. Accessible only to the user.

/users/{creatorId}/followers/{followerId.description: Stores the followers of a creator. Writeable by any authenticated user, readable by all.

/users/{userId}/notifications/{notificat.description: Stores notifications for a user. Accessible only by the owning user.

/videos/{videoId}.description: Stores video metadata. Publicly readable, but restricted write access.

/videos/{videoId}/comments/{commentId}.description: Stores comments for a video. Publicly readable, writeable by authenticated users.

/videos/{videoId}/likes/{userId}.description: Stores likes/dislikes for a video. Publicly readable, writeable only by the owning user.

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Stores video categories. Publicly readable, but restricted write access.

/tags/{tagId}.description: Stores video tags. Publicly readable, but restricted write access.
